Designature Studio — Website Plan: 1. Strategy & Positioning is the anchor — every backlog item should serve Option 3 today or Foundation/Option 2 readiness.
2. Backlog is the master list of work. Add new ideas as rows. Update Status as you make progress.
3. Roadmap groups Backlog items by phase (1–5 + Future) so you can see what's near vs far.
4. Customer Feedback captures real-user notes verbatim — discuss, then create Backlog items from them.
5. Visual & Feel is open canvas for design polish notes — mostly empty, fill in as ideas come.
6. Tier Matrix is reference for Free / Design / Studio plan boundaries.
7. Regression Tests is the manual test log — run before each meaningful release; add a row whenever you discover a new behavior worth re-checking.
8. Current State is a snapshot of what's live, locked, or in progress today (refresh as the site changes).

column2: Stable identifier. Format: PREFIX-NNN. Prefixes: S=Strategy, A=Architecture, AI=AI Studio, SL=Shopping List, I=Infra/CMS, AC=Account & Dashboard, F=Feedback, C=Content/Service, P=Performance/SEO, M=Mobile, VF=Visual/Feel, RT=Regression Test.
Short imperative phrase, e.g. 'Add visible Sign Up CTA to header'.
High-level area. Strategy, Architecture, AI Studio, Shopping List, Infra/CMS, Account & Dashboard, Customer Feedback, Content, Performance/SEO, Mobile, Visual/Feel.
Option 3 = supports designer-hero today. Option 2 = supports future AI-hero pivot. Both = needed under either. Foundation = architectural prep for the future swap.
P0 = must have soon. P1 = should have. P2 = nice to have. P3 = someday/maybe.
Idea · Discussed · Approved · In Progress · Done · Dropped.
S = under 1 day. M = 1–3 days. L = ~1 week. XL = more than a week.
1 Free polish · 2 Deploy · 3 CMS · 4 Paid tiers · 5 Strategy swap · Future = concepts to refine.
